brief: Should I buy IOC for the long term? Brief trader/thesis/IOC-brief.json, daily bars to 2026-10-29, no FII/DII flows file.

bull_case.point: Cheap on every valuation measure, even on mid-cycle earnings
bull_case.rupee_impact: yield 6.36% is about 318 rupees a year on 5,000

bear_case.point: Profit swings with crude and fuel pricing

traps.reason: it sits on peak FY26 profit of a cyclical PSU

verdict.changes_if: Q2FY27 results show a return to profit
verdict.rationale: The numbers are cheap but the earnings base is unstable.

handoff.note: Only if you decide to buy, then trader-risk.
